items.caption:
"People with very high expectations have very low resilience — and unfortunately, resilience matters in success."
— Jensen Huang, Founder & CEO, NVIDIA

Huang said this in an interview with the Stanford Graduate School of Business. "One of my great advantages is that I have very low expectations," he added — and resilience, he said, can't be taught: "I hope suffering happens to you."

His own path wasn't easy: born in Taiwan, he spent much of his early childhood in Thailand and moved to the U.S. at 9.

Source: Stanford GSB interview, via Fortune.
